name: fn_auth_any(text,text[])
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_auth_any(p_token text, p_permissions text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$

DECLARE

  v_email text := fn_auth(p_token, NULL);   -- SESI_HABIS kalau token tidak valid

  v_perm  text;

BEGIN

  FOREACH v_perm IN ARRAY p_permissions LOOP

    IF fn_has_perm(v_email, v_perm) THEN

      RETURN fn_auth(p_token, v_perm);        -- cek wajib-ganti-password + catat user audit

    END IF;

  END LOOP;

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Role % tidak punya akses untuk aksi ini.',

    fn_role_label((SELECT role FROM app_user WHERE email = v_email));

END;

$function$

name: fn_price_lookup(uuid,uuid,date)
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_price_lookup(p_variant_id uuid, p_supplier_id uuid, p_on date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS TABLE(price_id uuid, price numeric, currency text, valid_from date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT mp.id, mp.price, mp.currency, mp.valid_from
    FROM material_price mp
    JOIN material_variant v ON v.id = mp.variant_id
    JOIN material_supplier ms ON ms.id = mp.material_supplier_id AND ms.material_id = v.material_id
    JOIN supplier s ON s.id = ms.supplier_id
    JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id
   WHERE mp.variant_id = p_variant_id AND ms.supplier_id = p_supplier_id
     AND m.price_method = 'CATALOG' AND mp.status = 'APPROVED'
     AND ms.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
     AND mp.valid_from <= coalesce(p_on, fn_today())
     AND (mp.valid_to IS NULL OR mp.valid_to > coalesce(p_on, fn_today()))
   ORDER BY mp.valid_from DESC, mp.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 1
$function$

def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_similar_names(p_token text, p_kind text, p_text text, p_exclude uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(ref_id uuid, label text, info text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_email   text := fn_auth(p_token, 'view_master');
  v_factory uuid := fn_user_factory(v_email);
  v_key     text := fn_similar_key(p_text);
  v_kind    text;
BEGIN
  IF length(v_key) < 2 THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  IF p_kind = 'SUPPLIER' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT s.id, s.name, s.status
        FROM supplier s
       WHERE s.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude AND fn_similar_match(fn_similar_key(s.name), v_key)
       ORDER BY fn_similar_key(s.name) = v_key DESC, abs(length(fn_similar_key(s.name)) - length(v_key)), s.name
       LIMIT 8;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'COMPONENT' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT c.id, c.name, 'No. ' || c.number || ' · ' || c.status
        FROM component c
       WHERE c.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude AND fn_similar_match(fn_similar_key(c.name), v_key)
       ORDER BY fn_similar_key(c.name) = v_key DESC, abs(length(fn_similar_key(c.name)) - length(v_key)), c.number
       LIMIT 8;
  ELSIF p_kind = 'MATERIAL' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT m.id, m.name, m.category || ' · ' || m.uom || ' · ' || m.status
        FROM material m
       WHERE m.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude AND fn_can_see_factory(v_email, m.factory_id)
         AND fn_similar_match(fn_similar_key(m.name), v_key)
       ORDER BY fn_similar_key(m.name) = v_key DESC, abs(length(fn_similar_key(m.name)) - length(v_key)), m.name
       LIMIT 8;
  ELSIF p_kind LIKE 'OPTION:%' THEN
    v_kind := substr(p_kind, 8);
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT o.id, o.value, o.status
        FROM model_option o
       WHERE o.kind = v_kind AND o.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_exclude
         AND (o.factory_id IS NULL OR fn_can_see_factory(v_email, o.factory_id))
         AND fn_similar_match(fn_similar_key(o.value), v_key)
       ORDER BY fn_similar_key(o.value) = v_key DESC, abs(length(fn_similar_key(o.value)) - length(v_key)), o.value
       LIMIT 8;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Jenis pencarian % tidak dikenal.', p_kind;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

name: fn_master_usage(text,uuid,boolean)
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_master_usage(p_kind text, p_id uuid, p_published boolean)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT left(string_agg(x.label, ', ' ORDER BY x.label), 300)
    FROM (
      SELECT pm.name || ' ' || sp.season || ' (specsheet)' AS label
        FROM bom_line l
        JOIN specsheet_revision r ON r.id = l.revision_id
        JOIN specsheet sp ON sp.id = r.specsheet_id
        JOIN product_model pm ON pm.id = sp.model_id
       WHERE (r.status = 'PUBLISHED') = p_published
         AND CASE p_kind WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN l.supplier_id WHEN 'COMPONENT' THEN l.component_id END = p_id
      UNION
      SELECT pm.name || ' ' || sp.season || ' · ' || a.code || ' (CBD)'
        FROM cbd_line cl
        JOIN cbd_revision c ON c.id = cl.cbd_revision_id
        JOIN article a ON a.id = c.article_id
        JOIN specsheet sp ON sp.id = a.specsheet_id
        JOIN product_model pm ON pm.id = sp.model_id
       WHERE (c.status = 'PUBLISHED') = p_published
         AND CASE p_kind WHEN 'SUPPLIER' THEN cl.supplier_id WHEN 'COMPONENT' THEN cl.component_id END = p_id
    ) x
$function$

name: fn_cbd_expected_lines(uuid,uuid)
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cbd_expected_lines(p_article_id uuid, p_spec_rev_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(seq integer, line_key uuid, origin_line_key uuid, replaces_line_key uuid, component_id uuid, local_component_no integer, sub_seq integer, sub_name text, material_id uuid, thickness text, color text, variant_id uuid, supplier_id uuid, uom text, group_code text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH lines AS (
    SELECT l.*, c.number AS comp_no
      FROM bom_line l LEFT JOIN component c ON c.id = l.component_id
     WHERE l.revision_id = p_spec_rev_id AND l.is_active
  ), x AS (
    SELECT l.line_key, l.origin_line_key, l.replaces_line_key,
           CASE WHEN l.parent_line_key IS NULL THEN l.component_id ELSE p.component_id END AS component_id,
           CASE WHEN l.parent_line_key IS NULL THEN l.local_component_no ELSE p.local_component_no END AS local_no,
           CASE WHEN l.parent_line_key IS NULL THEN coalesce(l.comp_no, l.local_component_no)
                ELSE coalesce(p.comp_no, p.local_component_no) END AS top_no,
           CASE WHEN l.parent_line_key IS NULL THEN l.sort_order ELSE coalesce(p.sort_order, l.sort_order) END AS top_sort,
           l.parent_line_key IS NOT NULL AS is_sub,
           l.sub_seq, l.sub_name, l.material_id, l.thickness, bc.color, bc.variant_id, l.supplier_id, m.uom
      FROM lines l
      LEFT JOIN lines p ON p.line_key = l.parent_line_key
      JOIN bom_cell bc ON bc.bom_line_id = l.id AND bc.article_id = p_article_id AND bc.is_used
      JOIN material m ON m.id = l.material_id
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM revision_article ra
                    WHERE ra.revision_id = p_spec_rev_id AND ra.article_id = p_article_id AND ra.status = 'ACTIVE')
  )
  SELECT (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x.top_no NULLS LAST, x.top_sort, x.is_sub, x.sub_seq))::integer,
         x.line_key, x.origin_line_key, x.replaces_line_key, x.component_id, x.local_no, x.sub_seq,
         CASE WHEN x.is_sub THEN x.sub_name END, x.material_id, x.thickness, x.color, x.variant_id, x.supplier_id,
         x.uom, fn_cbd_group_code(x.component_id, x.local_no)
    FROM x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cbd_stage_options(p_token text, p_article_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(stage text, stage_order integer, spec_revision_id uuid, spec_label text, next_no integer, next_label text, available boolean, note text, is_default boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_email text := fn_auth_in(p_token, 'edit_cbd', fn_article_factory(p_article_id));
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM article WHERE id = p_article_id),
  maxpub AS (SELECT max(r.stage_order) AS o,
                    (array_agg(r.stage ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC))[1] AS s
               FROM cbd_revision r WHERE r.article_id = p_article_id AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED'),
  st AS (
    SELECT s.stage, s.ord::integer AS ord, sr.id AS sid, fn_rev_label(sr.stage, sr.revision_no) AS slabel,
           coalesce(ra.status, 'NOT_PUBLISHED') AS art_status,
           (SELECT coalesce(max(c.revision_no) + 1, 0)::integer FROM cbd_revision c
             WHERE c.article_id = p_article_id AND c.stage = s.stage) AS nno
      FROM unnest(fn_stages()) WITH ORDINALITY s(stage, ord)
      CROSS JOIN a
      JOIN specsheet_revision sr ON sr.id = fn_spec_latest_pub_stage(a.specsheet_id, s.stage)
      LEFT JOIN revision_article ra ON ra.revision_id = sr.id AND ra.article_id = a.id
  ),
  ev AS (
    SELECT st.*, (ov.s = 'ACTIVE' AND st.art_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (m.o IS NULL OR st.ord >= m.o)) AS ok,
           CASE WHEN ov.s = 'DROPPED' THEN 'Article di-drop di specsheet terbit terakhir'
                WHEN ov.s <> 'ACTIVE' THEN 'Article tidak ada di specsheet terbit terakhir'
                WHEN st.art_status = 'DROPPED' THEN 'Article di-drop di specsheet ' || st.slabel
                WHEN st.art_status <> 'ACTIVE' THEN 'Article tidak ada di specsheet ' || st.slabel
                WHEN m.o IS NOT NULL AND st.ord < m.o THEN 'Sudah ada CBD ' || fn_stage_label(m.s) || ' terbit'
           END AS why
      FROM st CROSS JOIN maxpub m
      CROSS JOIN (SELECT fn_cbd_article_spec_status(p_article_id) AS s) ov
  )
  SELECT ev.stage, ev.ord, ev.sid, ev.slabel, ev.nno, fn_rev_label(ev.stage, ev.nno), ev.ok, ev.why,
         ev.ok AND ev.ord = (SELECT max(e2.ord) FROM ev e2 WHERE e2.ok)
    FROM ev
   ORDER BY ev.ord;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_system_summary AS

           FROM product_model))::integer AS models,

           FROM specsheet))::integer AS specsheets,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM article))::integer AS articles,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cbd_revision))::integer AS cbd_revisions,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM material))::integer AS materials,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM app_user
          WHERE app_user.is_active))::integer AS active_users,
    (( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (c.reltuples < (0)::double precision) THEN ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM audit_log)
                    ELSE (c.reltuples)::bigint
                END AS reltuples
           FROM pg_class c
          WHERE (c.oid = ('audit_log'::regclass)::oid)))::integer AS audit_entries,
    ( SELECT max(audit_log.created_at) AS max
           FROM audit_log) AS last_audit,
    pg_total_relation_size('audit_log'::regclass) AS audit_size_bytes;

name: v_article_status
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_article_status AS
 SELECT a.id,
    a.specsheet_id,
    s.model_id,
    s.season,
    a.code,
    a.colorway,
    a.updated_at,
    a.updated_by,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM article_attachment t
          WHERE (t.article_id = a.id)) AS attachment_count,
    fn_article_is_used(a.id) AS is_used,
    fn_rev_label(rp.stage, rp.revision_no) AS pub_label,
    ( SELECT x.status
           FROM revision_article x
          WHERE ((x.revision_id = rp.id) AND (x.article_id = a.id))) AS pub_status,
    fn_rev_label(rd.stage, rd.revision_no) AS draft_label,
    ( SELECT x.status
           FROM revision_article x
          WHERE ((x.revision_id = rd.id) AND (x.article_id = a.id))) AS draft_status,
    fn_rev_label(cp.stage, cp.revision_no) AS cbd_pub_label,
    cp.sync_status AS cbd_pub_sync,
    fn_rev_label(cd.stage, cd.revision_no) AS cbd_draft_label
   FROM (((((article a
     JOIN specsheet s ON ((s.id = a.specsheet_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.id,
            r.stage,
            r.revision_no
           FROM specsheet_revision r
          WHERE ((r.specsheet_id = s.id) AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text))
          ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) rp ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN specsheet_revision rd ON (((rd.specsheet_id = s.id) AND (rd.status = 'DRAFT'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.stage,
            r.revision_no,
            r.sync_status
           FROM cbd_revision r
          WHERE ((r.article_id = a.id) AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text))
          ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) cp ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN cbd_revision cd ON (((cd.article_id = a.id) AND (cd.status = 'DRAFT'::text))));

name: v_cbd_article
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cbd_article AS
 SELECT a.id,
    a.specsheet_id,
    sh.model_id,
    sh.season,
    a.code,
    a.colorway,
    sp.id AS spec_pub_id,
    fn_rev_label(sp.stage, sp.revision_no) AS spec_pub_label,
    sp.stage AS spec_pub_stage,
    fn_cbd_article_spec_status(a.id) AS spec_status,
    d.id AS draft_id,
    fn_rev_label(d.stage, d.revision_no) AS draft_label,
    ((d.id IS NOT NULL) AND (d.specsheet_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM ds.id)) AS draft_stale,
    p.id AS pub_id,
    fn_rev_label(p.stage, p.revision_no) AS pub_label,
    p.sync_status AS pub_sync,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM cbd_revision x
          WHERE (x.article_id = a.id)) AS revision_count,
    fn_rev_label(ds.stage, ds.revision_no) AS draft_spec_label,
    COALESCE((p.stage_order < sp.stage_order), false) AS pub_behind
   FROM (((((article a
     JOIN specsheet sh ON ((sh.id = a.specsheet_id)))
     LEFT JOIN specsheet_revision sp ON ((sp.id = fn_spec_latest_pub(sh.id))))
     LEFT JOIN cbd_revision d ON (((d.article_id = a.id) AND (d.status = 'DRAFT'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN specsheet_revision ds ON ((ds.id = fn_spec_latest_pub_stage(sh.id, d.stage))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.id,
            r.stage,
            r.revision_no,
            r.sync_status,
            r.stage_order
           FROM cbd_revision r
          WHERE ((r.article_id = a.id) AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text))
          ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) p ON (true));

name: v_material_list
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_material_list AS
 SELECT m.id,
    m.factory_id,
    f.name AS factory_name,
    m.name,
    m.name_key,
    m.category,
    m.uom,
    m.price_method,
    m.status,
    m.updated_at,
    m.updated_by,
    COALESCE(v.variants, (0)::bigint) AS variant_count,
    COALESCE(v.active_variants, (0)::bigint) AS active_variant_count,
    v.thicknesses,
    v.codes,
    COALESCE(s.suppliers, (0)::bigint) AS supplier_count,
    s.preferred_supplier
   FROM (((material m
     JOIN factory f ON ((f.id = m.factory_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS variants,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (mv.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)) AS active_variants,
            string_agg(DISTINCT fn_thickness_label(mv.thickness), ', '::text) AS thicknesses,
            string_agg(mv.code, ' '::text ORDER BY mv.code) AS codes
           FROM material_variant mv
          WHERE (mv.material_id = m.id)) v ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (ms.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)) AS suppliers,
            max(sp.name) FILTER (WHERE ms.is_preferred) AS preferred_supplier
           FROM (material_supplier ms
             JOIN supplier sp ON ((sp.id = ms.supplier_id)))
          WHERE (ms.material_id = m.id)) s ON (true));

name: v_price_pending
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_price_pending AS
 SELECT mp.id,
    COALESCE(mp.batch_id, mp.id) AS batch_id,
    m.id AS material_id,
    m.factory_id,
    m.name AS material_name,
    m.uom,
    v.id AS variant_id,
    v.code,
    v.color,
    fn_thickness_label(v.thickness) AS thickness_label,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    mp.price,
    mp.currency,
    mp.valid_from,
    mp.reference,
    mp.created_by,
    mp.created_at,
    cur.price AS cur_price,
    cur.currency AS cur_currency,
    cur.valid_from AS cur_valid_from,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.price_method <> 'CATALOG'::text) THEN 'Material sekarang Quotation'::text
            WHEN ((ms.status = 'INACTIVE'::text) OR (s.status = 'INACTIVE'::text)) THEN 'Supplier nonaktif'::text
            WHEN (v.status = 'INACTIVE'::text) THEN 'Varian INACTIVE'::text
            WHEN (cur.valid_from > mp.valid_from) THEN (('Lebih awal dari harga berlaku ('::text || to_char((cur.valid_from)::timestamp with time zone, 'DD-MM-YYYY'::text)) || ')'::text)
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS problem
   FROM (((((material_price mp
     JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = mp.variant_id)))
     JOIN material_supplier ms ON ((ms.id = mp.material_supplier_id)))
     JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = ms.supplier_id)))
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = ms.material_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.price,
            o.currency,
            o.valid_from
           FROM material_price o
          WHERE ((o.material_supplier_id = mp.material_supplier_id) AND (o.variant_id = mp.variant_id) AND (o.status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (o.valid_to IS NULL))
          ORDER BY o.valid_from DESC
         LIMIT 1) cur ON (true))
  WHERE (mp.status = 'PROPOSED'::text);

            sh.season_sort,
            pm.factory_id,
            pm.name AS model_name,
            fn_spec_latest_pub(sh.id) AS rev_id
           FROM (specsheet sh
             JOIN product_model pm ON ((pm.id = sh.model_id)))
        ), recent AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT p.id,
            p.season_sort,
            p.factory_id,
            p.model_name,
            p.rev_id,
            p.rk
           FROM ( SELECT pub.id,
                    pub.season_sort,
                    pub.factory_id,
                    pub.model_name,
                    pub.rev_id,
                    dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY pub.factory_id ORDER BY pub.season_sort DESC) AS rk
                   FROM pub
                  WHERE (pub.rev_id IS NOT NULL)) p
          WHERE (p.rk <= 2)
        ), used AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT bl.material_id,
            bl.supplier_id,
            bc.variant_id,
            sh.model_name
           FROM (((recent sh
             JOIN bom_line bl ON (((bl.revision_id = sh.rev_id) AND bl.is_active AND (bl.supplier_id IS NOT NULL))))
             JOIN bom_cell bc ON (((bc.bom_line_id = bl.id) AND (bc.variant_id IS NOT NULL))))
             JOIN revision_article ra ON (((ra.revision_id = sh.rev_id) AND (ra.article_id = bc.article_id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
        ), gap AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT p.material_id,
            p.supplier_id,
            p.variant_id
           FROM (( SELECT DISTINCT used.material_id,
                    used.supplier_id,
                    used.variant_id
                   FROM used) p
             JOIN material m_1 ON (((m_1.id = p.material_id) AND (m_1.price_method = 'CATALOG'::text))))
          WHERE (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM fn_price_lookup(p.variant_id, p.supplier_id) fn_price_lookup(price_id, price, currency, valid_from))))
        )
 SELECT m.id AS material_id,
    m.name AS material_name,
    m.factory_id,
    s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    (count(DISTINCT g.variant_id))::integer AS variant_count,
    string_agg(DISTINCT v.code, ', '::text) AS codes,
    string_agg(DISTINCT u.model_name, ', '::text) AS models,
    bool_or((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (material_price mp
             JOIN material_supplier ms ON ((ms.id = mp.material_supplier_id)))
          WHERE ((ms.material_id = g.material_id) AND (ms.supplier_id = g.supplier_id) AND (mp.variant_id = g.variant_id) AND (mp.status = 'PROPOSED'::text))))) AS has_pending
   FROM ((((gap g
     JOIN used u ON (((u.material_id = g.material_id) AND (u.supplier_id = g.supplier_id) AND (u.variant_id = g.variant_id))))
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = g.material_id)))
     JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = g.supplier_id)))
     JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = g.variant_id)))
  GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.factory_id, s.id, s.name;

name: v_bom_grid
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_bom_grid AS
 SELECT l.id,
    l.revision_id,
    l.line_key,
    l.parent_line_key,
    (l.parent_line_key IS NOT NULL) AS is_sub,
    l.component_id,
    l.local_component_no,
    l.sub_seq,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.parent_line_key IS NULL) THEN COALESCE(c.number, l.local_component_no)
            ELSE COALESCE(pc.number, p.local_component_no)
        END AS group_no,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.parent_line_key IS NULL) THEN l.sort_order
            ELSE COALESCE(p.sort_order, l.sort_order)
        END AS group_sort,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.parent_line_key IS NULL) THEN (COALESCE(c.number, l.local_component_no))::text
            ELSE (COALESCE(((COALESCE(pc.number, p.local_component_no))::text || '-'::text), ''::text) || l.sub_seq)
        END AS display_no,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.parent_line_key IS NULL) THEN COALESCE(c.name, l.local_component_name)
            ELSE l.sub_name
        END AS display_name,
    ((l.component_id IS NULL) AND (l.parent_line_key IS NULL)) AS is_local,
    l.material_id,
    cc.codes AS material_code,
    m.name AS material_name,
    l.thickness,
    m.uom,
    m.status AS material_status,
    l.supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ms.status AS link_status,
    l.process,
    l.origin_line_key,
    l.replaces_line_key,
    COALESCE(cc.cells, '{}'::jsonb) AS cells,
    s.status AS supplier_status,
    COALESCE(cc.cell_codes, '{}'::jsonb) AS cell_codes,
    COALESCE(cc.yellow, 0) AS yellow,
    (u.id IS NOT NULL) AS undo_replace,
        CASE
            WHEN (u.id IS NOT NULL) THEN (um.name || COALESCE((' '::text || u.thickness), ''::text))
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS undo_material
   FROM (((((((((bom_line l
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = l.material_id)))
     LEFT JOIN component c ON ((c.id = l.component_id)))
     LEFT JOIN bom_line p ON (((p.revision_id = l.revision_id) AND (p.line_key = l.parent_line_key) AND p.is_active)))
     LEFT JOIN component pc ON ((pc.id = p.component_id)))
     LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = l.supplier_id)))
     LEFT JOIN material_supplier ms ON (((ms.material_id = l.material_id) AND (ms.supplier_id = l.supplier_id))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg((bc.article_id)::text, bc.color) FILTER (WHERE (bc.color IS NOT NULL)) AS cells,
            jsonb_object_agg((bc.article_id)::text, v.code) FILTER (WHERE (v.id IS NOT NULL)) AS cell_codes,
            string_agg(DISTINCT v.code, ', '::text) AS codes,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (bc.is_used AND (bc.variant_id IS NULL) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))::integer AS yellow
           FROM ((bom_cell bc
             LEFT JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = bc.variant_id)))
             LEFT JOIN revision_article ra ON (((ra.revision_id = l.revision_id) AND (ra.article_id = bc.article_id))))
          WHERE (bc.bom_line_id = l.id)) cc ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN bom_line u ON ((u.id =
        CASE
            WHEN (l.replaces_line_key IS NOT NULL) THEN fn_bom_undo_target(l.id)
            ELSE NULL::uuid
        END)))
     LEFT JOIN material um ON ((um.id = u.material_id)))
  WHERE l.is_active;

name: v_material_price
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_material_price AS
 SELECT (mp.id)::text AS row_key,
    mp.id,
    m.id AS material_id,
    m.factory_id,
    v.id AS variant_id,
    v.code,
    v.color,
    v.thickness,
    fn_thickness_label(v.thickness) AS thickness_label,
    v.status AS variant_status,
    ms.id AS link_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ms.status AS link_status,
    mp.price,
    mp.currency,
    mp.valid_from,
    mp.valid_to,
    mp.reference,
    mp.status,
    x.state,
        CASE x.state
            WHEN 'MENUNGGU APPROVAL'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'BERLAKU'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'AKAN BERLAKU'::text THEN 4
            WHEN 'DITOLAK'::text THEN 5
            ELSE 6
        END AS state_order,
    mp.reject_reason,
    mp.batch_id,
    mp.created_by,
    mp.created_at,
    mp.decided_by,
    mp.decided_at
   FROM (((((material_price mp
     JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = mp.variant_id)))
     JOIN material_supplier ms ON ((ms.id = mp.material_supplier_id)))
     JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = ms.supplier_id)))
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = ms.material_id)))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_price_state(mp.status, mp.valid_from, mp.valid_to) AS state) x)
UNION ALL
 SELECT ((('gap:'::text || v.id) || ':'::text) || ms.id) AS row_key,
    NULL::uuid AS id,
    m.id AS material_id,
    m.factory_id,
    v.id AS variant_id,
    v.code,
    v.color,
    v.thickness,
    fn_thickness_label(v.thickness) AS thickness_label,
    v.status AS variant_status,
    ms.id AS link_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    ms.status AS link_status,
    NULL::numeric AS price,
    NULL::text AS currency,
    NULL::date AS valid_from,
    NULL::date AS valid_to,
    NULL::text AS reference,
    NULL::text AS status,
    'BELUM ADA HARGA'::text AS state,
    2 AS state_order,
    NULL::text AS reject_reason,
    NULL::uuid AS batch_id,
    NULL::text AS created_by,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS created_at,
    NULL::text AS decided_by,
    NULL::timestamp with time zone AS decided_at
   FROM (((material m
     JOIN material_variant v ON (((v.material_id = m.id) AND (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
     JOIN material_supplier ms ON (((ms.material_id = m.id) AND (ms.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
     JOIN supplier s ON (((s.id = ms.supplier_id) AND (s.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
  WHERE ((m.price_method = 'CATALOG'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM material_price mp
          WHERE ((mp.material_supplier_id = ms.id) AND (mp.variant_id = v.id) AND ((mp.status = 'PROPOSED'::text) OR ((mp.status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND ((mp.valid_to IS NULL) OR ((mp.valid_to > fn_today()) AND (mp.valid_to > mp.valid_from))))))))));

name: v_revision_checklist
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_revision_checklist AS
 SELECT revision_id,
    specsheet_id,
    stage,
    revision_no,
    status,
    requires_reason,
    line_count,
    active_articles,
    unused_articles,
    inactive_materials,
    no_supplier_lines,
    yellow_cells,
    yellow_list,
    inactive_suppliers,
    ((active_articles = 0) OR (unused_articles IS NOT NULL) OR (inactive_materials IS NOT NULL) OR (no_supplier_lines > 0) OR (yellow_cells > 0) OR (inactive_suppliers IS NOT NULL)) AS blocked
   FROM ( SELECT r.id AS revision_id,
            r.specsheet_id,
            r.stage,
            r.revision_no,
            r.status,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM specsheet_revision o
                  WHERE ((o.specsheet_id = r.specsheet_id) AND (o.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text) AND (o.id <> r.id)))) AS requires_reason,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM bom_line l
                  WHERE ((l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active)) AS line_count,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM revision_article ra
                  WHERE ((ra.revision_id = r.id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))) AS active_articles,
            ( SELECT string_agg(a.code, ', '::text ORDER BY a.code) AS string_agg
                   FROM (revision_article ra
                     JOIN article a ON ((a.id = ra.article_id)))
                  WHERE ((ra.revision_id = r.id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM (bom_cell c
                             JOIN bom_line l ON ((l.id = c.bom_line_id)))
                          WHERE ((l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active AND (c.article_id = a.id) AND c.is_used)))))) AS unused_articles,
            ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT m.name, ', '::text) AS string_agg
                   FROM (bom_line l
                     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = l.material_id)))
                  WHERE ((l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active AND (m.status = 'INACTIVE'::text))) AS inactive_materials,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM bom_line l
                  WHERE ((l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active AND (l.supplier_id IS NULL))) AS no_supplier_lines,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM ((bom_cell c
                     JOIN bom_line l ON (((l.id = c.bom_line_id) AND (l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active)))
                     JOIN revision_article ra ON (((ra.revision_id = r.id) AND (ra.article_id = c.article_id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
                  WHERE (c.is_used AND (c.variant_id IS NULL))) AS yellow_cells,
            ( SELECT "left"(string_agg(DISTINCT (((m.name || COALESCE((' '::text || l.thickness), ''::text)) || ' · '::text) || c.color), ', '::text), 300) AS "left"
                   FROM (((bom_cell c
                     JOIN bom_line l ON (((l.id = c.bom_line_id) AND (l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active)))
                     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = l.material_id)))
                     JOIN revision_article ra ON (((ra.revision_id = r.id) AND (ra.article_id = c.article_id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
                  WHERE (c.is_used AND (c.variant_id IS NULL))) AS yellow_list,
            ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT (((s.name || ' ('::text) || m.name) || ')'::text), ', '::text) AS string_agg
                   FROM (((bom_line l
                     JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = l.supplier_id)))
                     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = l.material_id)))
                     LEFT JOIN material_supplier ms ON (((ms.material_id = l.material_id) AND (ms.supplier_id = l.supplier_id))))
                  WHERE ((l.revision_id = r.id) AND l.is_active AND ((s.status = 'INACTIVE'::text) OR (ms.status = 'INACTIVE'::text)))) AS inactive_suppliers
           FROM specsheet_revision r) x;

name: v_worklist_spec
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_worklist_spec AS
 SELECT 'DRAFT'::text AS kind,
    pm.id AS model_id,
    pm.name AS model_name,
    pm.factory_id,
    sh.id AS specsheet_id,
    sh.season,
    r.id AS revision_id,
    r.stage,
    r.revision_no,
    ck.line_count,
    ck.no_supplier_lines AS no_supplier,
    ck.active_articles AS article_count,
    ck.unused_articles,
    ck.inactive_materials,
    NULL::text AS article_codes,
    NULL::boolean AS has_revision,
    ck.yellow_cells,
    ck.inactive_suppliers
   FROM (((specsheet_revision r
     JOIN specsheet sh ON ((sh.id = r.specsheet_id)))
     JOIN product_model pm ON ((pm.id = sh.model_id)))
     JOIN v_revision_checklist ck ON ((ck.revision_id = r.id)))
  WHERE (r.status = 'DRAFT'::text)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'UNASSIGNED'::text AS kind,
    pm.id AS model_id,
    pm.name AS model_name,
    pm.factory_id,
    sh.id AS specsheet_id,
    sh.season,
    NULL::uuid AS revision_id,
    NULL::text AS stage,
    NULL::integer AS revision_no,
    NULL::integer AS line_count,
    NULL::integer AS no_supplier,
    u.n AS article_count,
    NULL::text AS unused_articles,
    NULL::text AS inactive_materials,
    u.codes AS article_codes,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM specsheet_revision x
          WHERE (x.specsheet_id = sh.id))) AS has_revision,
    NULL::integer AS yellow_cells,
    NULL::text AS inactive_suppliers
   FROM ((specsheet sh
     JOIN product_model pm ON ((pm.id = sh.model_id)))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS n,
            string_agg(a.code, ', '::text ORDER BY a.code) AS codes
           FROM article a
          WHERE ((a.specsheet_id = sh.id) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM revision_article ra
                  WHERE (ra.article_id = a.id)))))) u)
  WHERE (u.n > 0);

name: v_model_list

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_model_list AS
 SELECT m.id,
    m.factory_id,
    m.factory_name,
    m.name,
    m.category,
    m.construction,
    m.gender,
    m.last_no,
    m.outsole_mold,
    m.size_range,
    m.sample_size,
    m.updated_at,
    m.updated_by,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM specsheet x
          WHERE (x.model_id = m.id)) AS season_count,
    s.id AS specsheet_id,
    s.season,
    s.season_sort,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM article a
          WHERE (a.specsheet_id = s.id)) AS article_count,
    COALESCE((s.season_sort = max(s.season_sort) OVER (PARTITION BY m.id)), true) AS is_latest_season,
    ra.label AS spec_label,
    ra.active_articles AS spec_active_articles,
    rp.label AS spec_label_pub,
    rp.active_articles AS spec_active_articles_pub
   FROM (((v_model m
     LEFT JOIN specsheet s ON ((s.model_id = m.id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ((fn_rev_label(r.stage, r.revision_no) || ' · '::text) || r.status) AS label,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM revision_article x
                  WHERE ((x.revision_id = r.id) AND (x.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))) AS active_articles
           FROM specsheet_revision r
          WHERE (r.specsheet_id = s.id)
          ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) ra ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ((fn_rev_label(r.stage, r.revision_no) || ' · '::text) || r.status) AS label,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM revision_article x
                  WHERE ((x.revision_id = r.id) AND (x.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))) AS active_articles
           FROM specsheet_revision r
          WHERE ((r.specsheet_id = s.id) AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text))
          ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
         LIMIT 1) rp ON (true));

name: v_worklist_price_rejected
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_worklist_price_rejected AS
 SELECT mp.id,
    m.id AS material_id,
    m.factory_id,

    v.code,
    v.color,
    fn_thickness_label(v.thickness) AS thickness_label,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    mp.price,
    mp.currency,
    mp.reject_reason,
    mp.decided_by,
    mp.decided_at,

   FROM ((((material_price mp
     JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = mp.variant_id)))

           FROM material_price n
          WHERE ((n.material_supplier_id = mp.material_supplier_id) AND (n.variant_id = mp.variant_id) AND (n.id <> mp.id) AND (n.created_at >= mp.decided_at))))));

name: v_cbd_line
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cbd_line AS
 SELECT cl.id,
    cl.cbd_revision_id,
    cl.line_key,
    cl.status,
    cl.group_code,
    g.name AS group_name,
    g.sort_order AS group_sort,
    COALESCE(c.number, cl.local_component_no) AS comp_no,
        CASE
            WHEN (cl.sub_seq IS NOT NULL) THEN (COALESCE(((COALESCE(c.number, cl.local_component_no))::text || '-'::text), ''::text) || cl.sub_seq)
            ELSE (COALESCE(c.number, cl.local_component_no))::text
        END AS display_no,
        CASE
            WHEN (cl.sub_seq IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE(cl.sub_name, m.name)
            ELSE COALESCE(c.name, bl.local_component_name, ('Lokal '::text || cl.local_component_no), m.name)
        END AS display_name,
    (cl.sub_seq IS NOT NULL) AS is_sub,
    ((cl.component_id IS NULL) AND (cl.sub_seq IS NULL)) AS is_local,
    cl.material_id,
    v.code AS material_code,
    m.name AS material_name,
    cl.thickness,
    m.price_method,
    cl.color,
    cl.supplier_id,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    cl.uom,
    bl.process AS remarks,
    cl.yield_value,
    cl.usage_value,
    cl.loss_pct,
    cl.price_original,
    cl.currency,
    cl.price_source,
    cl.material_price_id,
    NULL::text AS master_price_color,
    mp.valid_from AS master_price_valid_from,
    cl.price_override_reason,
    cl.price_reference,
    x.price_usd,
    x.price_idr,
        CASE
            WHEN cl.no_charge THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE ((cl.usage_value * x.price_idr) * ((1)::numeric + (COALESCE(cl.loss_pct, (0)::numeric) / (100)::numeric)))
        END AS cost_per_pair,
    cl.value_origin,
    cl.value_source_ref,
    cl.sort_order,
    cl.variant_id,
    cl.no_charge,
    cl.no_charge_reason,
    cl.replaces_line_key
   FROM (((((((((cbd_line cl
     JOIN cbd_revision cr ON ((cr.id = cl.cbd_revision_id)))
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = cl.material_id)))
     LEFT JOIN material_variant v ON ((v.id = cl.variant_id)))
     LEFT JOIN component c ON ((c.id = cl.component_id)))
     LEFT JOIN component_group g ON ((g.code = cl.group_code)))
     LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ((s.id = cl.supplier_id)))
     LEFT JOIN material_price mp ON ((mp.id = cl.material_price_id)))
     LEFT JOIN bom_line bl ON (((bl.revision_id = cr.specsheet_revision_id) AND (bl.line_key = cl.line_key))))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE cl.currency
                    WHEN 'IDR'::text THEN cl.price_original
                    WHEN 'USD'::text THEN (cl.price_original * cr.exchange_rate)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS price_idr,
                CASE cl.currency
                    WHEN 'USD'::text THEN cl.price_original
                    WHEN 'IDR'::text THEN (cl.price_original / NULLIF(cr.exchange_rate, (0)::numeric))
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS price_usd) x);

name: v_cbd_price_check
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cbd_price_check AS
 SELECT l.id AS line_id,
    l.cbd_revision_id,
    cur.price_id AS master_price_id,
    cur.price AS master_price,
    cur.currency AS master_currency,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.price_source = 'QUOTATION'::text) THEN (m.price_method = 'CATALOG'::text)
            WHEN (m.price_method = 'QUOTATION'::text) THEN (l.price_source = 'MASTER'::text)
            ELSE (cur.price_id IS DISTINCT FROM l.material_price_id)
        END AS master_stale,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.price_original IS NOT NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (m.price_method = 'QUOTATION'::text) THEN 'QUOTATION'::text
            WHEN (l.supplier_id IS NULL) THEN 'NO_SUPPLIER'::text
            WHEN (cur.price_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'AVAILABLE'::text
            WHEN pend.pending THEN 'PENDING'::text
            ELSE 'NO_PRICE'::text
        END AS price_gap,
    NULL::text AS other_colors,
    ((m.price_method = 'CATALOG'::text) AND pend.pending) AS pending
   FROM ((((cbd_line l
     JOIN cbd_revision r ON ((r.id = l.cbd_revision_id)))
     JOIN material m ON ((m.id = l.material_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL fn_price_lookup(l.variant_id, l.supplier_id) cur(price_id, price, currency, valid_from) ON (true))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(fn_price_pending(l.variant_id, l.supplier_id), false) AS pending) pend)
  WHERE ((r.status = 'DRAFT'::text) AND (l.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (NOT l.no_charge));

name: v_cbd_recap
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cbd_recap AS
 SELECT r.id AS cbd_revision_id,
    r.status,
    r.exchange_rate,
    r.target_fob,
    t.material_cost,
    ci.labour,
    ci.amortization,
    ci.adjustment,
    ci.other,
    ci.items_total,
    f.actual_fob,
    (f.actual_fob - r.target_fob) AS variance,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.target_fob IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (f.actual_fob > r.target_fob) THEN 'OVER'::text
            WHEN (f.actual_fob < r.target_fob) THEN 'UNDER'::text
            ELSE 'SESUAI'::text
        END AS variance_label,
    t.line_count,
    t.unpriced_count,
    t.no_yield_count,
    t.usd_no_rate_count,
    t.missing_count,
    COALESCE(gc.group_costs, '{}'::jsonb) AS group_costs,
    r.stage,
    pf.po_factor,
    round((f.actual_fob * pf.po_factor), 2) AS po_price,
    t.no_charge_count,
    t.blank_count
   FROM (((((cbd_revision r
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(v.cost_per_pair) FILTER (WHERE (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS material_cost,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text)))::integer AS line_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (v.price_original IS NULL) AND (NOT v.no_charge))))::integer AS unpriced_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (v.price_original IS NOT NULL) AND (v.yield_value IS NULL) AND (NOT v.no_charge))))::integer AS no_yield_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (v.currency = 'USD'::text) AND (v.price_idr IS NULL) AND (NOT v.no_charge))))::integer AS usd_no_rate_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (v.status = 'MISSING_IN_SPEC'::text)))::integer AS missing_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND v.no_charge)))::integer AS no_charge_count,
            (count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (v.price_original IS NULL) AND (v.yield_value IS NULL) AND (NOT v.no_charge))))::integer AS blank_count
           FROM v_cbd_line v
          WHERE (v.cbd_revision_id = r.id)) t)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE (c.item_type = 'LABOUR'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS labour,
            COALESCE(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE (c.item_type = 'AMORTIZATION'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS amortization,
            COALESCE(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE (c.item_type = 'ADJUSTMENT'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS adjustment,
            COALESCE(sum(c.amount) FILTER (WHERE (c.item_type = 'OTHER'::text)), (0)::numeric) AS other,
            COALESCE(sum(c.amount), (0)::numeric) AS items_total
           FROM cbd_cost_item c
          WHERE (c.cbd_revision_id = r.id)) ci)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(x.group_code, x.cost) AS group_costs
           FROM ( SELECT v.group_code,
                    COALESCE(sum(v.cost_per_pair), (0)::numeric) AS cost
                   FROM v_cbd_line v
                  WHERE ((v.cbd_revision_id = r.id) AND (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))
                  GROUP BY v.group_code) x) gc)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (t.material_cost + ci.items_total) AS actual_fob) f)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text) THEN r.po_factor
                    ELSE ( SELECT s.po_factor
                       FROM stage_setting s
                      WHERE (s.stage = r.stage))
                END AS po_factor) pf);

name: v_cbd_checklist
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cbd_checklist AS
 SELECT cbd_revision_id,
    article_id,
    stage,
    revision_no,
    status,
    requires_reason,
    spec_status,
    spec_stale,
    rate_ok,
    stale_prices,
    no_yield_count,
    unpriced_count,
    line_count,
    missing_count,
    pending_prices,
    pending_list,
    ((spec_status <> 'ACTIVE'::text) OR spec_stale OR (NOT rate_ok) OR (stale_prices > 0) OR (no_yield_count > 0) OR (pending_prices > 0)) AS blocked,
    no_charge_count,
    unpriced_list,
    blank_count
   FROM ( SELECT r.id AS cbd_revision_id,
            r.article_id,
            r.stage,
            r.revision_no,
            r.status,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM cbd_revision o
                  WHERE ((o.article_id = r.article_id) AND (o.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text) AND (o.id <> r.id)))) AS requires_reason,
                CASE
                    WHEN (fn_cbd_article_spec_status(r.article_id) <> 'ACTIVE'::text) THEN fn_cbd_article_spec_status(r.article_id)
                    ELSE fn_cbd_stage_spec_status(r.article_id, r.stage)
                END AS spec_status,
            (r.specsheet_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM fn_spec_latest_pub_stage(a.specsheet_id, r.stage)) AS spec_stale,
            (r.exchange_rate IS NOT NULL) AS rate_ok,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM v_cbd_price_check pc
                  WHERE ((pc.cbd_revision_id = r.id) AND pc.master_stale)) AS stale_prices,
            rc.no_yield_count,
            (rc.unpriced_count - rc.blank_count) AS unpriced_count,
            rc.line_count,
            rc.missing_count,
            ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
                   FROM v_cbd_price_check pc
                  WHERE ((pc.cbd_revision_id = r.id) AND pc.pending)) AS pending_prices,
            ( SELECT "left"(string_agg(DISTINCT ((v.material_code || ' · '::text) || v.supplier_name), ', '::text), 300) AS "left"
                   FROM (v_cbd_price_check pc
                     JOIN v_cbd_line v ON (((v.id = pc.line_id) AND (v.cbd_revision_id = r.id))))
                  WHERE ((pc.cbd_revision_id = r.id) AND pc.pending)) AS pending_list,
            rc.no_charge_count,
            ( SELECT "left"(string_agg((((btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, v.display_no, v.display_name)) || ' ('::text) || v.material_name) || ')'::text), ', '::text ORDER BY v.group_sort, v.sort_order), 300) AS "left"
                   FROM v_cbd_line v
                  WHERE ((v.cbd_revision_id = r.id) AND (v.status = 'ACTIVE'::text) AND (v.price_original IS NULL) AND (v.yield_value IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT v.no_charge))) AS unpriced_list,
            rc.blank_count
           FROM ((cbd_revision r
             JOIN article a ON ((a.id = r.article_id)))
             JOIN v_cbd_recap rc ON ((rc.cbd_revision_id = r.id)))) x;

name: v_worklist_cbd
def:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_worklist_cbd AS
 WITH art AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT a.id,
            a.code,
            a.colorway,
            a.specsheet_id,
            sh.season,
            sh.model_id,
            sp.id AS spec_pub_id,
            sp.stage_order AS spec_stage_order
           FROM (((specsheet sh
             JOIN specsheet_revision sp ON ((sp.id = fn_spec_latest_pub(sh.id))))
             JOIN revision_article ra ON (((ra.revision_id = sp.id) AND (ra.status = 'ACTIVE'::text))))
             JOIN article a ON ((a.id = ra.article_id)))
        )
 SELECT kind,
    refresh_reason,
    article_id,
    article_code,
    colorway,
    model_id,
    model_name,
    factory_id,
    specsheet_id,
    season,
    cbd_revision_id,
    rev_label,
    pending_prices
   FROM ( SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (rc.n = 0) THEN 'TO_CREATE'::text
                    WHEN (d.id IS NOT NULL) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN ((d.specsheet_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM ds.spec_id) OR (pr.stale_prices > 0)) THEN 'TO_REFRESH'::text
                        ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS'::text
                    END
                    WHEN ((p.stage_order < art.spec_stage_order) OR (p.sync_status = 'NEEDS_REVISION'::text)) THEN 'TO_REVISE'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS kind,
                CASE
                    WHEN (d.id IS NOT NULL) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN (d.specsheet_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM ds.spec_id) THEN 'SPEC'::text
                        WHEN (pr.stale_prices > 0) THEN 'PRICE'::text
                        ELSE NULL::text
                    END
                    WHEN (p.stage_order < art.spec_stage_order) THEN 'STAGE'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS refresh_reason,
            art.id AS article_id,
            art.code AS article_code,
            art.colorway,
            pm.id AS model_id,
            pm.name AS model_name,
            pm.factory_id,
            art.specsheet_id,
            art.season,
            COALESCE(d.id, p.id) AS cbd_revision_id,
            COALESCE(fn_rev_label(d.stage, d.revision_no), fn_rev_label(p.stage, p.revision_no)) AS rev_label,
            pr.pending_prices
           FROM ((((((art
             JOIN product_model pm ON ((pm.id = art.model_id)))
             LEFT JOIN cbd_revision d ON (((d.article_id = art.id) AND (d.status = 'DRAFT'::text))))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_spec_latest_pub_stage(art.specsheet_id, d.stage) AS spec_id) ds ON ((d.id IS NOT NULL)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.id,
                    r.stage,
                    r.revision_no,
                    r.sync_status,
                    r.stage_order
                   FROM cbd_revision r
                  WHERE ((r.article_id = art.id) AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'::text))
                  ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC
                 LIMIT 1) p ON (true))
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS n
                   FROM cbd_revision c
                  WHERE (c.article_id = art.id)) rc)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.master_stale))::integer AS stale_prices,
                    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE pc.pending))::integer AS pending_prices
                   FROM v_cbd_price_check pc
                  WHERE (pc.cbd_revision_id = d.id)) pr)) x
  WHERE (kind IS NOT NULL);
